summary: Implemented handleUpdateKnowledge and handleDeleteKnowledge in mcp-server/gui/api.ts.
Updated KnowledgeUpdateBodySchema to accept superseded_by: null (via .nullable()) to enable field-clearing semantics.

handleUpdateKnowledge: validates rawId via parseKnowledgeId, validates body via KnowledgeUpdateBodySchema.safeParse, maps superseded_by: null → undefined, calls manager.updateInsight with scope/project_slug discriminator, catches missing-insight errors as NOT_FOUND.

handleDeleteKnowledge: validates rawId via parseKnowledgeId, requires scope query param (validated via InsightScope.safeParse), requires project_slug when scope==='project', calls manager.deleteInsight, catches missing-insight errors as NOT_FOUND, returns null.
Added 14 new WP-004 tests to tests/gui/api-knowledge.test.ts covering all 10 acceptance criteria.
All 2560 tests pass across 85 test files. Clean TypeScript compile.

comments.note: KnowledgeUpdateBodySchema at line ~1584 in gui/api.ts is exported, which is good for testability. The superseded_by field now uses .nullable().optional() to support explicit clearing — this is a deliberate semantic extension consistent with the null-as-clear idiom used elsewhere in the project.

The not-found error detection in handleUpdateKnowledge and handleDeleteKnowledge uses a substring match on the error message ('not found'). This is consistent with the KnowledgeStoreManager implementation (throws Error with message 'Insight with id X not found'). A stronger approach would be a typed error class, but that's a storage-layer change outside this WP's scope.

gui/api.ts is now 1940+ lines. The file is logically organized by endpoint section but is growing large. A future refactor splitting knowledge handlers into a dedicated module (e.g., gui/api-knowledge.ts) would improve navigability without changing the public API surface.

comments.note: ID validation runs before scope validation in handleDeleteKnowledge (line 1809 vs 1812). When both rawId and scope are invalid, the caller always sees a VALIDATION_ERROR for the ID. This is consistent with fail-fast on cheapest check first, and is not a defect — worth noting for the code reviewer as a deliberate ordering choice.

The not-found error detection in both handlers uses msg.includes('not found') substring match (lines 1774, 1829). This is consistent with the existing codebase pattern and the KnowledgeStoreManager error message contract. A typed error class would be more robust but is a storage-layer change outside this WP's scope — the Developer already flagged this in implementation comments.
No improvement needed — code is clean, well-documented, and consistent with existing handler patterns throughout gui/api.ts.

summary: Reviewed handleUpdateKnowledge and handleDeleteKnowledge in mcp-server/gui/api.ts (lines 1748–1836), KnowledgeUpdateBodySchema (lines 1587–1599), parseKnowledgeId helper (lines 1618–1630), and the full WP-004 test suite in tests/gui/api-knowledge.test.ts.
Both handlers conform precisely to the established handler pattern throughout gui/api.ts: validate ID → validate body/params → construct manager → try/catch with not-found mapping.

null→undefined mapping for superseded_by is correct: the three-way ternary handles all cases (null=clear, defined=set, undefined=omit). Verified that spreading { superseded_by: undefined } followed by InsightSchema.parse() cleanly removes the field from the stored insight.
TypeScript safety is sound: validationError() is typed as 'never', so all post-guard code is correctly narrowed. scopeResult.data is only accessed after the guard confirms success.
Scope disambiguation is correctly enforced by passing { scope, project_slug } to both updateInsight and deleteInsight — the storage layer restricts search to the matching store.
Substring not-found detection (msg.includes('not found')) is consistent with existing patterns and the stable storage-layer error contract. Already flagged as tech debt by Developer and QA.
